title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Work with dimensions
summary: This blog series covers dimensions in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including how to add shortcut dimensions and custom dimensions to pages, set up default dimensions at various levels, manage dimension priorities, use dimensions in financial reporting, and leverage dimension features across inventory, journals, and locations.
key_points: Index of the author's articles on dimensions in Business Central, from 2020 to 2024
Covers putting shortcut dimensions, other dimensions and a Dimensions FactBox on pages
Default dimension topics include priorities, allowed values filters, bulk assignment, account type defaults and defaults on locations, inventory documents and journals
Also covers changing global dimensions after go-live, dimension corrections on G/L entries and importing dimension combinations
Developer articles cover setting dimensions through the standard API and reading dimension captions in AL

quotes.text: Dimensions are a very powerful feature in Business Central.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes dimensions as core functionality for financial analysis and categorization

quotes.text: Dimensions are values that categorize entries so you can track and analyze them on documents.
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the fundamental purpose of dimensions for tracking and reporting
